verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API that can create, read, update, and delete store data in JSON, including a /wc/v3/products endpoint, with read/write API keys and official client libraries. WC-CLI also offers command-line store management, so catalog changes can be scripted rather than done product by product. However, the pack never shows a CSV import/export tool, a batch or bulk endpoint, or a bulk-edit UI, so bulk work rests on custom scripting. Missing for 10: native CSV product import/export, documented batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk edit in the dashboard, hands-on corroboration.
